about: The same restructuring task on the same pinned commits: a generic coding agent (G3: opencode 1.18.34 with NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on Nebius Token Factory, a fixed prompt, no human input) and architecture-cleaner. Every number is measured offline and names its source. The certificate rows are read from the certificate files in this directory and in runs/immich-ladder/.

The persistent run is the reference baseline, because single-shot runs quit within 3 minutes.
